scope: Windows x64 synthetic standalone battle and empty preparations: 216 numeric-branch comparisons, 65 boundary comparisons and 169 TARGET_ATTR comparisons, including valid, missing and out-of-int32 attributes, signed 64-bit numeric parameters, both condition slots and sparse variants.
